findings: BARb spends ~57-66% of metal on mobile-constructor (static) tasks; army stays tiny (army_m ~6k vs static ~50k at 40 min).
Raid squads only end when their leader dies -> survivors raid alone (the 'one by one' trickle).
Attack squads launch only at quota.attack (60 power) and abort below the quota they were created with.
BARb never builds Juno, anti-nuke, EMP/tac launcher, nukes, shields or walls (not in any build list it reaches).
Core reclaims old energy only when a new generator finishes and only within 1000 elmos of base.
Threat ranges only project for armed units, so jammer phantom threat works through enemy group influence, not the threat map.
GetFightType() is only on IFighterTask (needs cast<IFighterTask>).
Lobby hides non-whitelisted AIs: devmode.txt + Settings>Developer>untick simple AI list. Only the bot's owner needs Anarva installed.
Core gathers squads to max(quota, enemy 2nd-biggest group threat): unreachable once enemy blobs -> armies never launch. Fixed by script-owned wave tasks.
buildpowerRatio = constructor-vs-army knob (factory adds builder while buildpower < income*ratio).
Moho: +6 m/s for +17 E/s upkeep; T1 mex 3 E/s. Upgrades gated by energy headroom.
Top duel winners keep army value ~= eco value by 10 min; losers over-invest in static defence.
Config changes since first-gen (opener, ms_pull/buildpower, commander hide) are shared by every variant and must be bisected separately (profile anarva_fg, flag F_OPENER).
Geothermals are a core fallback only (energy planner ranks anywhere-placeable energy); script cannot see vents.
Side/map confound: with games==maps each map is played from one side only; compare variants paired, and move to both-sides (16 games) for final numbers.
Method: modules ship ON only after winning head-to-head vs first-gen; defaults = best-measured config.
Harness: games capped at 30 game-min, points verdict from min 20, 60 min wall; variants tested directly vs base (paired) on both sides.
Production chooser must leave constructors to the core (~30% of factory weights are builders); debt: measured marginal value of a constructor.
Approach change (user): fewer blind A/B batches; study how humans beat multiple BARbs and derive the reasoning.
1v3: every loss ends with army ~0, extractors collapsing 10-25 -> 2-5, commander dying at home 20-28 min. Expansion pulls the commander out (dies 1000-1400 from base).
Replay study correction: 3 of 6 'human vs several BARbs' games were FFA (bots fight each other). Allied 1vN: Knizek 1v4 (Ancient Bastion), NoviceKing99 1v3, FloBoo 1v8, Edict 1v2 Comet Catcher.

Edict (1 human vs 2 allied BARbs, Comet Catcher): ~20 light turrets + ~30 mines on the lanes by 8 min, static defence above each bot's 3-8 min, mass Gatling tanks 10-14 min, T2 at 13, push at 20 with 2x the bots' army. Defence first when the enemy comes to you.

1v3 single games after deficit-sized terrain defence: bots reach 43-91 M/s each vs ours 20-25; our extractors fall to 3-5. The deficit measure (needPower in power units) is too small when the enemy is unscouted; turret count stays low.

Refrog (1 human vs 2 allied BARbs, Center Command, 139 min): the factory cycles constructor, rez bot (cornecro), raiders, assault every round from minute 5; income passes the bots by minute 10 (45 vs 35 each) and reaches 2x by minute 15. Rez bots as a steady metal source alongside the army.

All-in at 12 min in a 1v2 (lost ~3000 metal far from home): trade estimate from ~85 s of kills swung 0.7 -> 5.1 on a few cheap kills, needed power fell 130 -> 21. Fix candidate F_STAKE: weight evidence by the army at stake.

Against two allied BARb-hard, Anarva is overrun by 26-36 min on every map type. 1v1 (2.25 vs BARb) does not carry over: the combined bots out-earn us ~3x and the script layer can't do the human counters (just-in-time army needs enemy positions; kill zones, transports, micro need unit commands).

1v2 income curve (Comet Catcher): Anarva matches each BARb until ~12 min (29.5 vs 26-40 M/s), then stalls at ~30 while the bots compound to 110 by 24 min and 240 by 36. Our outer extractors fall (13 -> 6) and T2/fusion only appears ~20-24 min.
